verdictSemantics.PASS: the recipe's actions executed (execution count > 0) and every expected outcome was met against live observation. This attests the DECLARED CONSTRUCTION SCOPE of the comet-050 revision only: the recorded-and-pinned real composition journey through the R/A/T/P gate extensions (real consensus, real independent reviews, real TDD), the live Kp/archive lock refusals, and the recipe/registration tracking of the full step plan. It NEVER asserts the full same-run terminal state — steps 7-11 (Kp, real OpenSpec archive, Outline unknown-result/restart recovery, Kt, completed) are execution_owner=VERIFY (execution-contract journey_execution); recipe validation alone does not close E01/E02/E06. The honest blockers of the pilot world (isolation initialState, submissionId collision, write-once per-gate artifacts across revise loops) are attested AS blockers; a PASS here never converts them into verified capability.
verdictSemantics.FAIL: the declared construction scope executed and the observed outcome contradicted the frozen THEN (a pinned consensus ballot or run-ledger digest drifted, the packaged Kp validator accepted a knowledge-less pass, a superseded run is recorded completed, or the case module reported failures)
verdictSemantics.NOT-EXERCISED: a prerequisite was missing (registered recipe, schema-valid definition, frozen pilot baseline, identity or environment — e.g. the pinned comet-050 build or the packaged composition is absent); structured refusal with nonzero exit, never converted into a pass
verdictSemantics.NOT-APPLICABLE: explicitly out of scope for the registered profile with a recorded reason; still nonzero; the runner never self-assigns it
